"''''Double Edge'''" was the call sign of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
At one point during the Galactic Civil War, "Double Edge" was engaged in a [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]] with two Rebellion starfighters. He managed to destroy both an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] as well as another fighter at the same time.<ref name="XWM" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
"Double Edge" was a skilled pilot who stand out over other elite pilots, which allowed him to be trained to fly the expensive, multi-role TIE Aggressor starfighter. He was known to be relentless in pursuing his enemies in battle.<ref name="FFG.com" />
